bead.title: Bound hybrid async SQLite flush batches to protect hot-path latency
bead.description: Fix the 100k hybrid-async hot-path tail failure by ensuring background deferred SQLite checkpoint apply cannot hold the composed backend mutex for an unbounded batch. In scope: projection-store deferred apply chunking, flush cadence/batch sizing, tests and perf evidence. Out of scope: changing durability semantics or weakening bars.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-server --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_deferred_flush_chunking -- --nocapture` passes and proves a partial flush leaves unapplied commands queued, then a later flush catches up exactly once.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_async_apply_exactly_once -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale PQUEUE_PERF_ENV=1 PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=100000 cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m -- --ignored --nocapture` passes or writes a blocker log naming the post-chunking bottleneck without weakening the gate.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
